basis: User-designated current working tree, including uncommitted changes; snapshots are evidence, not executable imports.

adaptations.identity.ts: Strict JSON identity, preserve __proto__ and reject cycles/non-JSON objects; SHA256 uses existing js-sha256 dependency.
adaptations.leaseGuard.ts: Domain-free error; actual persisted renewal deadline instead of estimating from response time.
adaptations.protocol.ts: Domain-neutral resources and execution context; injected runtime schema instead of copying Zod/Prisma/book scope.
adaptations.registry.ts: Prepare/parse/pin/attest/execute/output validation; host authorization and fencing required. Local effect transactions will be provided by agent-sqlite; registry alone does not claim exactly-once.
adaptations.resources.ts: Resource registry with exact version refs and empty-result collection revisions; no book-specific URI canonicalization.
